mentions.name: Foxhole availability calendar (Doodle alternative)
mentions.description: This website lets people set their availability on a calendar, similar to Doodle, with no account required, timezone support, and no cost; the author is building it to coordinate Foxhole players taking responsibility for areas so a General Manager is always online.
mentions.problem: Existing scheduling tools like Doodle are basically impossible to find with the requirements of no account, timezone support, and being free.
mentions.audience: Foxhole players coordinating General Manager coverage
mentions.source_excerpt:
But a website in which people can set their availability on a calendar. Kinda like Doodle. My requirements are:
- no account necessary
- timezone support
- not have to pay for it
Basically impossible to find something which fills those requirements.
So I am coding myself a handy tool.
For what? To coordinate people for the game Foxhole to take responsibility for certain areas so we always have a General Manager online
